Lore: Relic Ring (Bound)

Worth more than gold on the Eastside of Termalaine, and everybody there knows it. It has the following Powers:

  • Resistance: Favor on Saves and damage reduction against Cold. The wearer is unharmed by Blistering Cold.

Value: 2500g
system.source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden (Vagabond conversion)
